definition.title: Circular wait recovery
definition.mechanism: Multi-unit mode NAIVE: total (2 Compute, 2 Memory); A and B each declare maximum (2,2).

steps.label: Complete A if its claim is held
Complete B if its claim is held

assumptions: Declared maximum claims. Multi-instance deadlock uses current-request reduction; avoidance uses Banker's safe-sequence check.
Recovery restarts a victim with zero holdings and requeues its full claim. After the restart limit it is protected; unresolved recovery is reported, never hidden.
No hardware is used. Cost-weighted recovery uses accumulated work plus held units, with youngest-process ties.
